# Bagback AI Workspace Showcase — Specification & Entity Metadata (llms-full.txt)

## 1. System Overview & Public Showcase Mission
This repository (`mohamedosamaai/ai-workspace-showcase`) serves as the official public showcase and TypeScript contracts repository for **Bagback AI Workspace** (`ai.bagbacktech.com`). It demonstrates the architectural design, C4 models, security scanning schemas, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration without exposing internal databases or proprietary server code.

## 4. Technical Architecture & Mock Strategy
- **Client Types:** Pure TypeScript 5.x contracts with strict typing.
- **Mock Layer:** Client-side 10-vector security scanner, token estimator, and mock MCP server registry.
- **Zero Data Leaks Policy:** Proprietary weights, private API keys, and internal database connection strings are 100% excluded from public repositories.
